About.subtitle: The leading product comparison platform for the UAE
About.mission: At "{siteName}" we believe every consumer deserves reliable and objective information before making a purchase. Our mission is to save you hours of research and give you the bottom line — what are the best products in every category.

research.title: In-Depth Research
research.desc: We review hundreds of products and analyze technical specs, user reviews and sales data

objective.title: Objective Comparison
objective.desc: Our rankings are based on real-world performance, not payments or advertising

recommendations.title: Clear Recommendations
recommendations.desc: We explain simply why each product is recommended and who it's best suited for

reliability.desc: — Our information is accurate and up-to-date. We don't recommend products we wouldn't buy ourselves.

transparency.desc: — We're open about how we earn. When you buy through our links, we may receive a commission.

consumerFirst.desc: — Every decision we make is evaluated from your perspective — the consumers.

About.teamIntro: Meet the expert reviewers behind our recommendations:

adham.bio: Cooking and baking enthusiast. Reviews kitchen appliances, coffee machines and home electronics.

mariam.bio: Musician and sound enthusiast. Reviews speakers, headphones and audio systems.

fatima.bio: Interior design and beauty lover. Reviews beauty products, skincare and home accessories.

abdulla.bio: Athlete and fitness trainer. Reviews smartwatches, fitness equipment and sports electronics.

sara.bio: Mother of three. Reviews baby products, toys and family essentials.
